title: A phone that leaves out the askId walks round the writing ask door
body:
## Summary
Both writing routes consulted the phone ask door only when the body carried an askId, so a paired phone with no ask open could get a model-coached note and save an episode to the seated learner's record.

## Description
desk/src/app/api/writing/coach/route.ts:47 and desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:47 branched on `"askId" in body`; a body without it went to the stateless /writing page path whatever the caller's role. TL-11 (docs/concepts/TV-LED-PAIRED-EXPERIENCE-DESIGN-2026-10-19.md:373) says a phone answers the open ask and nothing else, and every other result route (read, mark, analyse, second, hint, explain) always calls withPhoneAsk, which refuses a phone with no askId (desk/src/lib/session/phoneAsk.ts:28). Registry: authorization / dispatch-chokepoint-gating (the caller chose whether the gate ran) and failure-direction (an absent askId was more permissive than a wrong one). Fixed: a phone always goes through withPhoneAsk; the TV and in-process callers keep the page path.

## Flow
- a paired phone posts {promptId, draft} to /api/writing/coach with no ask open
- Before: 200 and one model call; After: 409 NOT_ASKING, no call
- the same phone posts {promptId, draft, note, revision} to /api/writing/finish
- Before: 200 and a writing history line on the seated learner; After: 409, nothing written

## Expected impact
The learner record and the model budget can no longer be moved by a phone outside the TV's hand-off. A phone browser opening /writing directly now gets 409; nothing in the product links a phone there (grep for "/writing" outside the writing modules: 0 hits).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the phone answers only the TV's open writing ask
Before: phone, no askId: coach 200 + 1 model call; finish 200 + 1 history line (probe, then writing-tv-test red)
After: coach 409, 0 calls; finish 409, 0 lines; tv role with no askId still 200
Method: gate - writing-tv-test went red then green on the change
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
desk/src/app/api/writing/coach/route.ts:47  if ("askId" in body) return withPhoneAsk(...)
desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:47  if (body && ... && "askId" in body) return withPhoneAsk(...)
desk/src/app/api/read/route.ts:20  export function POST(req) { return withPhoneAsk(req, ["page"], () => post(req)); }
probe: phone coach no ask: 200 model calls 1; phone finish no ask: 200; file history [ 'Screens before bed' ]

title: The coaching note is not held to the two sentences the coach asks for
body:
## Summary
COACH_SYSTEM asks for one note of at most two sentences, but coachNote showed any non-empty note the ghostwriting guard passed, with no length cap in code or schema.

## Description
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:45 (the prompt) against desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:56-59 (the door). The TV draws the note at 46 px under the prompt, the progress and two action cards (desk/src/writing/WritingTV.tsx:56), so a long note runs off the 1080 canvas. Registry: structured-output / schema-validation-and-repair, domain checks: strings within length caps from the same authority the prompt was rendered from. Fixed: NOTE_MAX_SENTENCES = 2 and NOTE_MAX_CHARS = 240 (about twice the code's longest line, 109 chars), in the check and as the schema maxLength; past either, the code line is shown.

## Flow
- the model answers a three-sentence or 262-char note that hands over no sentence
- Before: it is shown on the TV (source model)
- After: the code's line for the focus is shown (source code)

## Expected impact
A learner on the TV always gets a note that fits the screen. A legitimately longer model note is replaced by the code line, which is the note the product already falls back to.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the note obeys the prompt's own limit
Before: 3-sentence 87-char note -> model; 2-sentence 262-char note -> model
After: both -> code; a 74-char 2-sentence note -> model (unchanged); every code line <= 240 (pinned)
Method: gate - writing-rules-test red (missing constant), then green; Before taken by a stub probe
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:45 "Reply with ONE short note (at most two sentences)"
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:42 SCHEMA note: { type: "string" } (no maxLength)
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:57 if (!said) return { note: fallback ... }
probe Before: model 87 / model 262

title: The one-note coach call asks the fast model with thinking on
body:
## Summary
coachNote did not pass thinking: false, while every other short fast call in the desk does and the TV waits with its keys frozen.

## Description
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:52-55 called ask({model:"fast", ...}) with no thinking flag; AskNote even declares it (desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:13). The repo measured the switch (desk/src/lib/engines/text.ts:28-30, 2026-09-25, haiku, n=15): on ~7k output tokens, 52-90 s, 5 timeouts; off ~220 tokens, 4-6 s, none. Siblings: desk/src/lib/desk/items.ts:350, desk/src/lib/desk/memory.ts:107, desk/src/lib/desk/worked.ts:49 and five calls in desk/src/lib/english/conversation.ts pass it. Meanwhile desk/src/tv/keys.ts:410 freezes the Writing keys while busy.

## Flow
- the phone sends a paragraph; the route marks the episode busy
- Before: the CLI may reason for tens of seconds while the TV reads "The desk is reading your paragraph."
- After: the call goes out with MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0

## Expected impact
The learner waits seconds, not up to a minute, for one note. The note is still guarded and capped with the code line as fallback; a live check of note quality is the operator's.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - one short note without hidden reasoning
Before: short fast call sites with thinking off: 8 of 9; writing-coach request thinking undefined
After: 9 of 9; thinking false (pinned in writing-rules-test)
Method: gate - gate on the request shape; the latency figure is the repo's own A/B (n=15, 2026-09-25), not re-run because a gate makes no live call
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:53 system: COACH_SYSTEM, schema: SCHEMA, model: "fast", use: "writing-coach"
desk/src/lib/engines/text.ts:30 thinking on, ~7k output tokens, 52-90 s and 5 timeouts in 15 calls; off, ~220 tokens and 4-6 s, none
grep "thinking: false" desk/src: 8 sites

title: The /writing page can save "coached on ..." for a paragraph never coached
body:
## Summary
The finish route's page path accepted note "" as proof of the coaching step, so a skipped step saved a history line claiming coaching.

## Description
desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:2-4 says a body that skips a stage is refused, but the coached stage was attested only by typeof note === "string" (desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:48); episode.coached accepts any note (desk/src/lib/writing/episode.ts:47-51) and the save writes checkLine's "coached on X" (desk/src/lib/writing/save.ts:19). The page always sends the coach route's note, which is never empty (codeNote fallback), so only a skipped step sends "". Fixed: an empty or blank note is a 400 with its own line.

## Flow
- POST /api/writing/finish {promptId, draft, note:"", revision} as the TV
- Before: 200, history "2 sentences, coached on evidence; ..."
- After: 400 "Get the coaching note on your paragraph before you finish.", nothing saved

## Expected impact
The learner's history no longer claims a coaching that did not happen. A non-empty forged note still passes; the TV path is unaffected (its note is the session's).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a history line says coached only after a note existed
Before: note "" and "   ": 200 + 1 line each
After: 400, 0 lines
Method: gate - writing-tv-test red then green
Result: better
Gate: policy-tighten
evidence:
desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:48 typeof body.note !== "string"
desk/src/lib/writing/episode.ts:47 export function coached(ep, draft, note: string)
probe: phone finish no ask, empty note: 200 {"episode":{"stage":"finished",...,"note":""

title: The prompt list's caption is not announced as the D-pad walks it
body:
## Summary
On the Writing prompt list the caption changes with every Up/Down but was not a live region, unlike the chosen-prompt caption in the same file and the landing's announce line.

## Description
desk/src/writing/WritingTV.tsx:34 (list caption, no aria-live) against desk/src/writing/WritingTV.tsx:72 (chosen-prompt caption, aria-live polite) and desk/src/landing/themes/paper/Paper.tsx:302 (desk-announce). Fixed: the list caption is aria-live="polite".

## Flow
- a screen-reader user opens Writing and presses Down
- Before: nothing is spoken; After: the lit prompt's task is announced

## Expected impact
Screen-reader users hear which prompt is lit. Nothing drawn changes; VoiceView on the stick is unverified.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - focus moves are announced on both phases
Before: captions with aria-live: 1 of 2
After: 2 of 2
Method: gate - writing-tv-test source check red then green; no screen-reader device in the run
Result: better
Gate: none

desk/src/writing/WritingTV.tsx:34 <div className="cap-text" data-role="writing-caption">
desk/src/writing/WritingTV.tsx:72 <div className="cap-text" data-role="writing-caption" aria-live="polite">

title: Nothing drives the coach route with a failing engine, or the page path's finish to a save
body:
## Summary
error-doors-test credits writing-rules-test with the coach route's failing-engine case, but that suite only names the route in a comment; no route-level failing-engine case and no 200 page-path finish existed.

## Description
tools/error-doors-test.cjs:52 maps 'writing/coach' to writing-rules-test.cjs, satisfied by the comment at tools/writing-rules-test.cjs:18; that suite drives coachNote with a hand-rolled ask, not the route. Busy clearing (desk/src/app/api/writing/coach/route.ts:38-40) and the ask closing on a failed call were unpinned, and the page path's rebuild + saveEpisode (desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:51-58) had no 200 case. Added both to tools/writing-tv-test.cjs.

## Flow
- stub the text provider to throw; post the phone's paragraph through the writing ask
- assert 200, source code, stage coached with the code note, busy false, ask closed; the page path also answers code
- page path: unchanged revision 400, then a whole episode 200 with one history line

## Expected impact
A regression in the failure path or the stateless save is caught by the desk gate.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the failure path and the page save are pinned
Before: route-level failing-engine cases 0; page-path finish 200 cases 0
After: 2 and 1; seeded control (coachNote rethrows, saveEpisode skipped) turns both red
Method: gate - gate with a seeded control
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
tools/error-doors-test.cjs:52 'writing/coach':'writing-rules-test.cjs'
tools/writing-rules-test.cjs:18 // a stub engine (the api/writing/coach route's failing-engine door is the 'down' case below)
seed run: fail 2; restored: pass

title: Essay Master's landing line names a Writing episode as an Essay lens
body:
## Summary
essayWaiting takes the last kind "writing" history line as Essay Master's last reading, so after a Writing episode the Essay object reads "Screens before bed lens · 2 sentences, coached on ...". The Essay recap tile goes non-empty with zero readings the same way.

## Description
desk/src/tv/landingRows.ts:152 filters on h.kind === "writing" only; desk/src/tv/recapRows.ts:99 likewise sets empty: null for any writing line. desk/src/tv/writingScreen.ts:85 already tells the two apart (a label that is a prompt title). Fix: export one predicate (isWritingEpisode) from the writing side and use it at both sites, so Essay reads only its own lines. Out of this round's paths (landing, recap).

## Flow
- a learner with an Essay reading does a Writing episode on the TV
- Back to the landing, lamp on Essay Master
- the caption reads "Screens before bed lens · 2 sentences, coached on evidence; the revision now gives evidence."
- with only an episode tonight, the Essay recap tile renders non-empty with no readings

## Expected impact
The Essay object stops describing a prompt as a lens; the recap tile shows its empty line. Risk: the Essay "last" line falls back to its lens line when the last writing line is an episode.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - each app's caption describes its own work
Before: probe: essayWaiting line "Screens before bed lens · 2 sentences, coached on evidence; the revision now gives evidence."; episode-only recap {"empty":null,"readings":[]}
After: predicted: the lens line ("Argument lens, last read.") and the recap's empty line
Method: probe - Before probed on the real rows; After not built: the sites are another context's
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: a landingRows/recapRows rows test with history [an Argument reading, a "Screens before bed" writing episode] and with the episode alone: essayWaiting(s).line must not contain "Screens before bed lens"; the essay recap tile must be empty when its only writing lines are episodes

title: Writing episodes count as Essay Master readings on the Language lens
body:
## Summary
saveEpisode records every Writing episode into Essay Master's Language lens, so a learner who only did Writing shows Essay Master as read on Language with 1 paragraph; whether that is right is an owner question.

## Description
desk/src/lib/writing/save.ts:11,22 recordWriting(learnerId, "language", ...); desk/src/tv/writingRows.ts:24 counts every writing history line into Essay's "paragraphs read". The design note lists it as an open decision (docs/concepts/TV-WRITING-SCREEN-2026-10-21.md, Follow-ups). Escalation: direction - what a Writing episode is to Essay Master.

## Flow
- a learner does one Writing episode and no Essay reading
- Essay Master on the landing: kind last, lens Language, read 1

## Expected impact
Decides whether Essay Master's counts and Language estimate move on Writing. Either answer is a small change in save.ts and writingRows.ts.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - which app a Writing episode belongs to
Before: probe, episode-only learner: essay {"kind":"last","lens":"language","read":1}
After: depends on the ruling
Method: probe - the figure is reproducible; the benefit is a product decision no instrument settles
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction

title: A /writing page save leaves the session history stale
body:
## Summary
The TV path re-reads the learner record on writing.finished (REHYDRATE) so the landing says what was written at once; the page path saves through the same saveEpisode and re-reads nothing.

## Description
f6d9e93f fixed "the landing said Not started after a save" for the TV path only (desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:1089 REHYDRATE has writing.finished). desk/src/app/api/writing/finish/route.ts:56-58 saves with no event. Dispatching writing.finished from the page path is unsafe (it would finish a TV episode at stage coached), so the fix needs a store-side rehydrate event that touches no episode. Out of this round's paths (store.ts).

## Flow
- the PC finishes an episode on /writing
- the learner file holds the episode; the session history does not
- the TV landing says "Not started" on Writing until another rehydrating event

## Expected impact
The landing and recap show a page-path episode at once. Risk: a new event in the store's REHYDRATE set.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - both save paths leave the session current
Before: probe: file history ['Screens before bed'], session history []
After: predicted: session history holds it
Method: probe - Before probed; the fix lives in store.ts
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: writing-tv-test: after a page-path finish 200, getSession().history.at(-1).label is the prompt title (Before: file 1 line, session 0)

title: A coached note can land on a prompt picked after the paragraph was sent
body:
## Summary
writing.coached and writing.finished carry no promptId, and the reducer matches only stage and learner, so a result for an earlier episode lands on a newer one.

## Description
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:929-930 check s.writingTv.stage and s.learner.id only. During the model call (keys frozen except Back, desk/src/tv/keys.ts:404,410), a learner switch away and back drops the episode (desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:715) and a new pick starts a write stage for the same learner; the late note and draft for the first prompt then land on the second, and finish saves them under the second title. Fix: the events carry promptId and the reducer drops a mismatch. Out of this round's paths (store.ts).

## Flow
- send a paragraph for Screens before bed; the desk reads it
- switch learner and back, pick School uniform
- the note lands: School uniform shows a note about the screens paragraph

## Expected impact
Closes a narrow window (one model call, 4-6 s typical, up to 90 s). Falsified if learner.set does not clear writingTv.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a result lands only on the episode it answers
Before: walked: the reducer accepts writing.coached for any write-stage episode of that learner
After: predicted: dropped on promptId mismatch
Method: simulation - simulation over store.ts:715,925,929; the reducer is another context's
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:929 case "writing.coached": if (s.writingTv?.stage !== "write" || s.learner?.id !== e.by) return s;
desk/src/lib/session/store.ts:715 n.writingTv = null;
instrument: a reducer case in writing-tv-test: writingTv {promptId:"uniform",stage:"write"} then writing.coached for a draft sent on "screens" (same learner) must leave the session unchanged

title: Writing episodes are told apart from Essay readings by a prompt-title list
body:
## Summary
writingWaiting recognises an episode by label in the current prompt titles; a renamed title drops every past episode from the count and the "last time" line.

## Description
desk/src/tv/writingScreen.ts:80,85 (TITLES); desk/src/lib/writing/save.ts:21 stores label: p.title and no prompt id. Today 5 titles, 4 lens names, 0 collisions, so nothing is wrong yet; the list is hand-kept and the history has no discriminator. Fix: save the prompt id on the history line (learners.ts HistoryEntry, another context) and match on it, title as fallback.

## Flow
- retitle "Screens before bed"
- past episodes stop matching TITLES
- the landing says "Not started" for a learner with episodes

## Expected impact
Copy edits to prompts stop rewriting learners' history counts. Risk: a HistoryEntry field change.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the discriminator does not depend on copy
Before: walked: matched by title only
After: predicted: matched by id
Method: simulation - simulation; the field lives in learners.ts
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/writingScreen.ts:80 const TITLES = new Set(WRITING_PROMPTS.map((p) => p.title));
desk/src/lib/writing/save.ts:21 addHistory(learnerId, { at: ep.finishedAt, kind: "writing", label: p.title, detail });
instrument: a writing-rules case: rename a prompt title in a fixture and assert writingWaiting still counts the episode saved under the old title (Before: done drops to 0)

title: The Writing design note says busy freezes Back, and that a missing askId is the page
body:
## Summary
docs/concepts/TV-WRITING-SCREEN-2026-10-21.md says "any key while the desk reads or saves: nothing moves", but Back leaves the screen; and it says a body without askId is the /writing page, which is no longer true for a phone (2eccb124).

## Description
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:404 handles Back before the busy guard at desk/src/tv/keys.ts:410, which is the right behaviour; the note's table is wrong. The route sentence predates 2eccb124. Out of this round's paths (docs/).

## Flow
- press Back while the desk reads the paragraph
- the TV goes to the landing; the note says nothing moves

## Expected impact
The design note matches the code a builder reads it against.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - the doc states the shipped key map
Before: 2 stale statements
After: 0
Method: probe - read against code; the doc is another context's
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:404 if (k === "back") { ... o.nav("landing", ...) }
desk/src/tv/keys.ts:410 if (s.writingTv?.busy) return;
instrument: diff the note's key table and hand-off section against desk/src/tv/keys.ts:404-410 and the two writing routes

title: A model note the guard or cap replaced leaves no trace on the TV path
body:
## Summary
coachNote returns source "code" for four reasons, but only an engine failure is ledgered (meter.ts); the TV route drops `source` entirely, so how often the model note is thrown away is unknown.

## Description
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:57-62 fall back silently; desk/src/app/api/writing/coach/route.ts:36-37 puts the note on the session and returns source to a phone that ignores it (desk/src/app/phone/WritingPanel.tsx:32). A paid call whose answer was discarded books as a success. Registry: structured-output / extraction-observability.

## Flow
- the model hands over a sentence; the guard replaces it
- the ledger row says the call succeeded; nothing says the learner got the code line

## Expected impact
The operator can see whether the coach prompt earns its call. No user-visible change.

## Evaluation
Claim: other - failures of the model note are counted
Before: reasons traced: 1 of 4
After: 4 of 4
Method: simulation - the replacement rate needs live calls; the counter is the instrument
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence:
desk/src/lib/writing/coach.ts:58 const guarded = guardNote(said, ...);
desk/src/app/api/writing/coach/route.ts:37 return NextResponse.json({ episode: getSession().writingTv, source });
instrument: a counter (or one log line) in coachNote naming why the code line was used (empty, long, guard, failed), asserted in writing-rules-test; then a week of TV episodes gives the replacement rate
